title: Tower Stack 3D
description: Time every tap to stack sliding neon 3D slabs sky-high—slice away overhangs with razor precision or chain perfect snaps to expand your towering skyscraper.
controls: Tap anywhere at the exact moment the moving slab aligns with the tower beneath it to lock it cleanly in place.

zh-CN.title: 3D 叠高楼
zh-CN.description: 极简魔性节奏堆塔神作：看准时机一键定格滑行方块，切掉多余边角或触发完美重合冲击直插云霄的摩天高塔！
zh-CN.controls: 当移动方块与下方高塔重合瞬间点击屏幕即可落下堆叠，连续完美对齐可触发连击特效。
